user.title: tapNdo
user.description: tapNdo has nothing to set up here. After this, add your reminders from the tapNdo integration page with Add reminder.

user.title: New reminder
user.description: Fixed reminders follow the calendar (every day at 11:00). After-last-done reminders follow you: they come due a set time after you last did it.

schedule.title: Schedule
schedule.description: Window: how many hours it stays due before it counts as missed. 0 means until the end of the day. Every N days counts from the day you create the reminder.

data.interval: Every N days, or how long after last done

tags.title: NFC tags
tags.description: Tapping any of these tags on a reader completes the reminder. Tags are optional: the Done button and the notification buttons always work. Tick Scan a new tag to add one by touching it to a reader next.

notify.title: Notifications
notify.description: Choose where reminders go: at least one service or entity in the first two fields. Companion app services (mobile_app_...) also get Done and Snooze buttons. Nagging repeats every N minutes, up to the maximum. Escalation is optional: it adds more targets from the chosen reminder number on (the number must be 1 or more).

data.require_home: Only notify while one of these people is home

extras.title: More options
extras.description: Quiet hours hold notifications back. The reminder itself still changes state. Scripts run when the reminder becomes due, is done or is missed.

data.early_completion: A tap before the due time counts as done

progress.scan: Hold the tag against a reader now. This step waits for 60 seconds.

error.unknown_service: This notify service does not exist.
error.quiet_both: Set both the start and the end, or neither.
error.targets_missing: Choose at least one notify target here. Escalation targets are only added to these, they are not used on their own.
error.escalate_needs_number: Escalation targets need a reminder number of 1 or more, otherwise they are never used.

complete.name: Complete
complete.description: Marks the reminder done, as if its tag had been tapped.

snooze.name: Snooze
snooze.description: Hides a due reminder for a while.

minutes.name: Minutes
minutes.description: How long to snooze. Defaults to the reminder's own snooze time.

skip.name: Skip
skip.description: Skips the current occurrence without changing the streak.

reset.name: Reset
reset.description: Clears the history and streak and starts the schedule again from now.

missing_target.title: A notify target no longer exists
missing_target.description: A tapNdo reminder tries to notify {target}, but Home Assistant does not have it. Change the reminder or restore the integration that provides it.

missing_tag.title: A tag is no longer registered
missing_tag.description: The reminder {reminder} listens for the tag {tag}, which is not in Home Assistant's tag list. Re-add the tag or change the reminder. The Done button still works.
